scope.alias_note: 'כל-השיעורים-בספר-X' pages are flat aggregations; their new-UI equivalent is /category/:bookId (code-level descendant aggregation). No ops emitted from them; their items are covered via canonical pages.

method: Ground truth = old listing rows (old_listings_neviim_moadim.json) joined to match/item_match.json (deterministic global matcher, see match/MATCH-README.md).

Page-to-series mapping = item_match mapped_series_id, with 3 remaps from draft migration placeholders (parent=נביאים root) to their populated twins, +2 overrides for the unmapped ישעיהו pages (לב הפרק dup resolution, תנ"ך בעיון creation).

Canonical home of an item = nearest existing listing page above its old href (alias segments stripped). Canonical here = membership ops; displayed elsewhere = copy for parity when target is not an ancestor (new UI aggregates descendants only).

Matched lesson already in page series = set_lesson_sort only. Synonym rule: identical normalized (title,rabbi) published row already in target series (chapter_fallback copies) = bind to it instead of moving/copying.
Current placement old-justified (some old page maps to that series and lists the item) = copy_lesson; unjustified = move_lesson.

Unmatched old items: canonical home in scope = insert_lesson (media classified to audio/video/attachment; Rule 13: bneyzion.co.il-hosted URLs go only into attachment_url_old with rehost:true; S3-bucket URLs kept direct, like prior gap-closing inserts); Q&A rows insert with source_type=qa + rabbi_page_item(kind=qa). Canonical home out of scope = yoav_review cross_plan_dependency, no insert (avoids double-insert across parallel plans).
sort_order = the row position (order column) on its old page, unique per (lesson,series); set_series_sort emitted only from the series canonical parent page.

Rabbi attribution: old non-empty vs new empty = set_lesson_rabbi(high); spelling variant (SequenceMatcher>0.85) = op(med); real conflict = yoav_review only. '(לנשים)' suffix stripped (old-site audience label, not part of the name).
normalize_he everywhere: NFC + niqqud strip + quote/separator strip + whitespace collapse + lowercase.
_meta.ref_semantics: ops may reference not-yet-existing rows: create_series and insert_lesson carry tmp_id; later ops reference them via series_ref/lesson_ref ('tmp_*'). Real rows use series_id/lesson_id UUIDs. series_ref on set_lesson_sort disambiguates which copy of a copied lesson the sort applies to.
